draft.subject: Next step for Cedar Dynamics
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for bearing with us on the two questions you raised. To recap: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and I've noted your interest. On the other one, a second admin can be added from Account Settings any time -- useful before you're out next week.

You've got a project going and an invite out, which is the right start. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting real work in there is what makes week one count.

Want me to walk through that next step with you on a 15-minute call this week?

Best,
Priya
